review: Unde scrie asta — that is my first question about everything, and I have been checking this catalog against the Cornilescu for four months with a notebook. This one survives. "Legământul Pe Care Nu-l Poate Frânge." The covenant he cannot break. Hesed rendered into Romanian without being softened into simple kindness, which is what every Romanian hymnal I own does with it. My assembly has no instruments and no clergy and a very high view of the text, and I concede a point cleanly when I lose one. I lost one here. Five stars.
